assumptions.choice: No pre-market/after-hours bars exist in the feed (only 09:30-15:30 regular-session hourly bars). Proxied the pre-market/after-hours liquidity-sweep test using each day's first bar: if it wicks through the prior day's low/high and closes back inside, that flags a bullish/bearish liquidity sweep for the day.
assumptions.reason: Spec requires pre-market/after-hours session data not present in the OHLCV feed; closest literal reading uses the first available bar as the carry-over signal from the unobserved overnight session.

assumptions.choice: Interpreted '24 hours (or 5 trading sessions)' as 5 sessions x 7 bars/session = 35 bars.
assumptions.reason: The feed only has hourly bars during the 6.5h regular session, so literal 24 calendar hours spans non-contiguous days; spec offers the 5-session reading as an explicit alternative.
Spec says 'average price over the last 24 hours/5 sessions'; SMA of close is the plainest literal reading and lets backtrader auto-manage minperiod/warm-up per canonical default 6.

assumptions.choice: 20-bin histogram of volume by bar (high+low)/2 typical price over the trailing 35-bar window, recomputed once per new trading day from completed prior bars; HVN = max-volume bin, LVN = min-volume bin.
assumptions.reason: Spec names HVN/LVN conceptually but gives no bin count, window, or update cadence; declared reasonable, deterministic parameters.

assumptions.choice: New high (bull) / new low (bear) of the current trading day, checked only after that day's liquidity-sweep flag is set; resets each day.
assumptions.reason: Spec says BOS is 'a new high/low' during the main session but gives no lookback window; session-relative new high/low is the most literal, data-available reading.

assumptions.choice: Last opposite-colour candle (bearish for bullish OB, bullish for bearish OB) found within 10 bars preceding the BOS breakout bar.
assumptions.reason: Standard ICT OB definition; 10-bar search window is a declared choice since the spec gives no explicit lookback.

assumptions.choice: Standard 3-candle ICT fair value gap: bullish when bar[-2].high < bar[0].low, bearish when bar[-2].low > bar[0].high.
assumptions.reason: Spec names FVG but does not define it; this is the canonical construction implied by 'upper/lower boundary of the FVG'.

assumptions.topic: TP/SL selection between Fib level and Volume Profile level
assumptions.choice: When both a Fib level and an HVN/LVN level are valid (on the correct side of entry), use whichever is nearer to entry (tighter SL, more conservative TP). Skip the trade if no valid stop is derivable.
assumptions.reason: Spec states each target/stop as 'X or Y' without a priority rule; nearer-of-two is a deterministic, risk-conservative reading, and a trade cannot be sized without a valid stop.

assumptions.choice: Stop placed exactly at the OB zone boundary or VP level itself, no additional buffer.
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'below/above' the zone but gives no numeric offset; using the boundary itself avoids inventing an unstated distance.
Spec's own text cuts off mid-example on 'if the risk per trade is 1%...'; used that stated figure, which sits within the spec's 1-2% cap.

assumptions.choice: size = floor(risk_pct * portfolio_value / (entry_price - stop_price)); skip trade if size rounds to 0 shares.
assumptions.reason: Directly implements the spec's stated 'distance from entry to stop determines position size' rule.

assumptions.choice: All FVG breakout, OB zone-entry, and Fib crossover checks use bar close price (not intrabar wicks).
assumptions.reason: Keeps zone-entry and 'simultaneous' Fib-crossover checks consistent on a single reference price, since the spec does not specify intrabar handling.

assumptions.topic: Volume Profile 'confirm BOS and OB zones'
assumptions.choice: Not implemented as a separate filter; Volume Profile is only used for the explicitly numeric TP/SL rules (HVN/LVN).
assumptions.reason: Spec states this usage generally but gives no concrete confirmation rule/threshold; adding one would be inventing an unstated filter.

assumptions.topic: One position at a time / order guard
assumptions.choice: Applied canonical defaults 3 and 5 (single position, pending-order guard reset in notify_order).
assumptions.reason: Spec is silent on concurrency handling.
